author: B Codex personal permission-stage mechanism and finite hand reasoning
question: Can PTW admission use the last resident payload-owner dependency, rather than only walk age/cost/request count, to choose a useful next actual permission?
decision: Retain a conditional last-reference feedback interface and a precise coalition design. The singleton scene has a real contiguous-source interpretation and useful physical release difference, but a permission-stage Concentrate/WBA extension matches it. Root's initial coalition scene is also matched by largest occupancy plus partner continuation. Neither scene establishes independent innovation or current-DUT benefit; no RTL is justified this round.

capacity_modes.guaranteed_partition: If P=sum(Q_f) and every ingress/held/committed/spill hard reference is charged to its real Q_f, a full pool with an arriving flow below its own Q necessarily has a reclaimable soft-only cell. Do not manufacture a free-Q/all-hard-full pool stall. In that mode last-owner selection can reduce physical occupancy integral or optional history sacrifice, but this card does not prove a new mandatory-throughput opportunity.
capacity_modes.selected_positive_mode: A work-conserving shared total-credit pool with physical P smaller than the sum of configured per-flow maxima. Each allocation checks an actual free cell; configured Q_f are per-flow caps, not simultaneously guaranteed reservations. Sharing can support more logical references than physical cells. All compared controls get the same pool, metadata, optional reclaim, legal credit rules and available outstanding/walker resources.
capacity_modes.scope_change: This selected mode is explicit, not a silent change to the old P6=sum(Q_V3+Q_A3) guarantee. Source admission must reserve or otherwise prove a real return/drain envelope; no already selected source R may be bypassed to rescue a blocked PTE.

common_architecture_contract.source: Every participating owner independently acquired its actual own READ and accepted the resident words under compatible stable Normal immutable-source attributes. READ acquisition is not cell release; the copy references remain through real target W. Source original RLASTs in these initial states have already handshaken.
common_architecture_contract.target: Resident target quanta have known original destination VA/context and are within a page. A successful own WRITE grant can enable exactly those real bytes; a grant is not shared authority between SIDs. All scopes/access_ok/PA/attrs/cookies are actually acquired and held through the corresponding real B.
common_architecture_contract.pre_aw: Candidate permission requests are selected before a common W-owner has been locked by their target AW. A common paid pre-AW prepare/local permission queue and trusted success/result route is necessary. If A's original AW has already locked the shared input W owner, preparing B cannot make B W retire and this scene's benefit does not apply.
common_architecture_contract.actual_source_limit: Root reports the production native path has two TC lifecycle banks and that first AW offer locks W ownership through input WLAST. Four queued preparation candidates therefore require common new queue/cookie/result ownership interfaces; they cannot be declared four existing free native contexts.
common_architecture_contract.queue_and_records: Charge one request metadata entry per eligible candidate and actual success storage/ownership credit before issue. Finished source-stage fields can legally be reclaimed. In the serial hand environment each earlier fully resident WRITE finishes before the next grant, so permission result storage need not be four simultaneously live PA records. A two-walker version requires the same additional real walker and concurrent result credits for every controller.
common_architecture_contract.immutability: No already offered PTW AR, target AW/W or held R is withdrawn. The rule acts at the next admission only; a published response/data cell stays pinned. All per-ID ordering, target bytes and original B/ACK obligations remain real.
common_architecture_contract.service: The hand examples use a single nonpreemptive walker with equal service H for each cold leaf, grant usable after common g, target AW accepted at that usable point, first true W after a, subsequent true W separated by w, and real B after b from WLAST. These are declared legal hand service parameters, not measured cycles or MIG matching.

fields: Per-cell remaining hard owner/ref-class mask, including ingress/held-R pins and copy-token ownership; soft optional refs are separately reclaimable.
Per resident head token: original job/context, destination page/grant identity, byte coverage, actual own-READ status and current owned-WRITE status.
Per unissued permission: complete scope/access type, remaining walk estimate, queue age/arrival order, actual result-storage credit and current instruction/batch identity where supplied.
Actual held W owner/committed downstream obligations and the legal fully resident quanta that can really retire under each prospective grant.
minimal_executable_rule.drain_set: D(G) consists of already authorized resident copy owners and owners whose exact missing WRITE grant is in G, provided their real head quanta can retire without another READ, PTE or earlier blocked original job. Incoming/held-original-R or other non-W refs are not silently counted as drained. A READ grant alone adds no payload release.
minimal_executable_rule.closure: F(G)={c: every remaining hard reference to c can retire in D(G), and every nonreclaimable optional/published-response ref is also accounted}. R(G)=number of such physical cells. WRITE success for only A cannot release an A/C shared cell while C remains blocked.
minimal_executable_rule.singleton_version: At a next PTW admission, prefer a feasible WRITE request with greater R({p}); use current cost/age ties and the overdue override. This is a narrowly useful input not present in age/PWC/block-count alone, but generic exclusive-child completion principles already suggest it.
minimal_executable_rule.coalition_version: Enumerate only actually eligible missing-owner WRITE sets G of size at most2, not arbitrary jobs. Preserve the nonadditive R(G) and real W/AW/B work. Choose a set for a declared objective, such as earliest release curve or final cells per completed walk budget; do not call R(G) alone a latency optimizer. Submit only the first legal walk and recompute at its completion; do not create an uninterruptible hidden batch.
minimal_executable_rule.fairness: After K other walk admissions while continuously eligible, an entry becomes overdue. Select oldest overdue ahead of the release score, recomputing between coalition members. With bounded queue N, a request is selected after at most K+N-1 other admissions. A wall-clock bound additionally needs a real bounded service H_max; fair-but-unbounded R/W READY gives no finite cycle bound. Conditional with H_max, completion is bounded by approximately (K+N)H_max plus the real grant pipeline. Source/permission faults use the actual terminal error path.
minimal_executable_rule.important_limit: The score is an admission estimate, not a promise that future READY or a denied grant retires normal payload. Its predicted release must not turn actual grant acquisition into W completion, or free a cell still needed by another owner.

contiguous_source_singleton_scene.state: P6 work-conserving pool. A/C each hold three tokens for the same contiguous physical source S3, stored as cells s0/s1/s2 with mandatory owner mask{A,C}. B holds three tokens for different contiguous source T3 in cells t0/t1/t2 with mask{B}. A/B/C each have cap3; sum caps9, not a reservation guarantee. All three READs are already valid; their one original AW3 each waits for its own target WRITE permission P_A/P_B/P_C.
contiguous_source_singleton_scene.two_equal_candidates: P_A and P_B have equal H, age, PWC score, one blocked original AW, three blocked payload beats, WRITE type and per-flow occupancy3. R({P_A})=0; R({P_B})=3. C's independently missing WRITE cannot be assumed granted by A's successful walk.
contiguous_source_singleton_scene.fair_complete_controls: All destination AWs are fully resident and all granted quanta write exactly3 true words; no single-child cap is imposed. Any available other descriptors/walkers may be used identically. Source prehistory is two physical dataAR3/trueR6, nine successful logical R across A/B/C; target trueW9/AW3/realB3; three cold WRITE walks and three real successful copy ACKs remain in either order.

one_explicit_hand_order.useful_difference: Both have the same complete work, ACK sum63 and makespan29. Release-first returns the first physical cell8 slots sooner and reduces the six-cell occupancy integral from138 to114 cell-slots. This is a real declared-state release difference, not proof of generic throughput or paper novelty. A queued new source can use actual returned cells only under its own real authorization/return envelope.

simple_baselines.FCFS: With tied entry age and fixed route-order A,C,B, choose A and free0 initially; another legal tie order can happen to choose B and match. No guarantee that every FCFS instance loses.
simple_baselines.shortest_walk: Equal remaining H leaves the same tie; it has no additional owner input in this state.
simple_baselines.max_blocked: Each permission blocks one original AW and three W beats; equal counts do not reveal that only B is the last owner.
simple_baselines.WRITE_first: All are WRITE, so it does not distinguish.
simple_baselines.max_occupancy: All are occupancy3, so its tie policy can choose A or B. The owner permutation changes the good decision without changing those unary numbers.
simple_baselines.ISCA2018_actual_batch_score: Allow the full reported policy: recent-instruction batch first, otherwise minimum whole-instruction PWC memory-reference score with shared instruction sum, then age, plus aging. Give each of these three independent DMA batches one walk with scoreH and tied age; a fixed oldest/route A can still be chosen. If A/C are actually in a two-walk instruction group and B is a one-walk group, its real group-score policy can itself prefer B. Do not suppress that matched case or replace the policy merely with shortest walk.
simple_baselines.stage_aware_Concentrate_WBA: A concrete matched extension treats each shared cell as a packet with residual destination mask; prefer the next permission that completes the most unicast residual cells. It chooses B's three singleton cells before A/C's two-child cells and gives the same B,A,C trajectory. Original eligible-W arbitration alone cannot issue B before permission, but its upstream permission preference plus the paid feedback interface can. This matches the example; it is not a claim the 1997 paper already contains this PTW interface.

neighbors: If C already owns usable WRITE and can drain while the walker runs, A/C may cease to be shared before P_A becomes usable. A score that permanently predicts free0 for A is then stale; include real ready-owner work or recompute, and do not assume an arbitrary held W will clear by a deadline.
If the shared W owner was already irrevocably locked to A's untranslated AW, B's grant cannot retire B first. This pre-AW scheduling scene does not apply.
If P=sum(Q) and all Q are guaranteed as in the original two-flow design, the occupancy advantage does not imply the manufactured hard-allocation stall used in this work-conserving scene.

root_proposed_coalition.state: P5 work-conserving hard pool, four flows. A/C each own shared resident head3 with cells s0/s1/s2 and mask{A,C}; B and D each own one exclusive resident head cell. All own READs are valid. Four distinct own WRITE page grants P_A/P_C/P_B/P_D are missing, with equal H and age. Caps are not simultaneous P=sum(Q) guarantees.
root_proposed_coalition.nonadditive_action: R({A})=R({C})=0, R({A,C})=3. R({B})=R({D})=1 and R({B,D})=2. Two A/C grants plus their real six W retire three physical cells. Two B/D grants plus their real two W retire two physical cells. The extra four true W must be counted.

H8_complete_hand.complete_cost: Both perform four same-H WRITE walks, trueW8, AW4, realB4 and four real ACKs. Existing source history has physicalR5/logicalR8. No payload source reread or NULL is invented.
H8_complete_hand.tradeoff: A/C reaches three freed cells by20 versus34, and cell occupancy integral117 versus133; first freed cell is18 versus10. Makespan35 versus37, ACK sum96 in both. The makespan difference is also compatible with ordinary longer-quanta-first scheduling, not an exclusive mask-based benefit.

root_proposed_coalition.early_arrival_failure: A ready one-word follow-on workload that can legally stream with one returned physical cell benefits from B's first release10 rather than waiting for A/C's first release18. Per-flow older write/ID obligations, its READ/WRITE leases, source service and real W/B must also be honored. No universal faster arrival claim follows from the later three-cell count.
root_proposed_coalition.strong_simple_match: Largest resident occupancy selects A3 ahead of B1/D1; a partner-continuation rule records C as the other owner of A's chosen source cells and requests C on the next permission admission. Since A is fully resident and its grant really succeeds, its W retires before C's grant in the H8 scene. This produces the same A,C,B,D trajectory without enumerating a general maximum-closure coalition. Therefore this root hand scene does not distinguish the coalition algorithm from the strongest simple control.
root_proposed_coalition.two_walker_boundary: If the budget really includes two independent walkers and two success-result credits, every controller gets both. A/C grants can then complete together; largest occupancy also selects both and matches the coalition. Real W still totals6 before those three shared cells disappear. Native two TC banks are not automatically two independent PTW engines; concurrency must be established from the actual interface.
root_proposed_coalition.stage_aware_Concentrate_WBA_match: A matched upstream extension chooses the largest resident packet/flow first and continues its missing destination partner before moving to an unrelated packet. It also requests A,C. This is a real simple continuation algorithm. Generic last-child retirement/Concentrate principles are covered by root's exact primary review; mapping blocked data-owner sets into pre-AW permission admission is the narrower new interface, not proof of a new scheduling principle.

root_information_separation_family.formal_state: Five hard cells with two-owner edges. CaseI: AB1,AC1,AD1,BC2. CaseII: AB1,AC2,BC1,BD1. CaseIII: AB2,AC1,BC1,CD1. Every case has occupancies A3/B3/C3/D1, equal pending grant ages/remaining cost, and singleton immediate release0.
root_information_separation_family.joint_difference: The maximal two-grant closure is BC2 in caseI, AC2 in caseII, AB2 in caseIII. A unary fixed choice cannot distinguish the cases without ownership information. This is a bounded information separation, not a legal producer/complete-job performance witness.
root_information_separation_family.continuity_gap: Three single continuous immutable source intervals cannot realize the pair-only triangle with no ABC word: pairwise intersecting intervals have a common intersection. Do not call each flow's three words one free AR3/AW3 in that formal graph.
root_information_separation_family.what_a_possible_multi_descriptor_realiza: Using individual one-word shared subreads for the five physical cells would require five physical dataAR/R and ten original one-word COPY/source-R obligations across A3/B3/C3/D1. It also requires ten corresponding true W and original AW/B obligations unless a separately charged legal aggregation interface is provided. Multiple resident COPY descriptors, ordering metadata, page-grant reuse/normal cached lookups and actual own-result lifetimes must be established. This is a cost obligation/suggested construction, not a claim the native two-TC path executes it.
root_information_separation_family.block_count_gap: Any grouping into fewer 1+2 descriptors changes original blocked-request counts unless the construction deliberately pays all individual requests. Equal word occupancy is not automatically equal blocked-AR/AW counts. A claimed information family must keep those observable fields genuinely equal.
root_information_separation_family.next_distinct_question: Can a real continuous-scope or fully charged multi-descriptor state retain equal unary cost/age/blocked/occupancy observations while useful joint release masks differ? Root must establish that one actual state and its strongest continuation control before any model/RTL.

upstream_preparation_control.required: Compare the same paid architecture using prepare-all-destination-before-source and one-page WRITE lookahead. Known descriptor destination addresses permit an ordinary controller to avoid resident payload waiting for WRITE in many cases. Charge actual cold walks, occupied result slots, source fragmentation and all original completions; do not make that controller carry four free PA records or freeze consumed fields.
upstream_preparation_control.state_origin: The conditional resident state is legal under independent READ/WRITE progress or an accepted source envelope crossing a new destination page beyond finite lookahead while old grant records are still held through B. The new pre-AW queue permits the pending destination work to become eligible. This does not prove a prepare-before-read controller must pass through the same state.
upstream_preparation_control.stop_condition: If the same-budget destination lookahead/preparation or simple partner continuation removes the trigger or gives the same complete benefit, do not enter RTL on this scene. Retain the exact feedback interface/safety accounting and redesign the claimed performance question. No ordinary control is forbidden to reuse legally consumed lifecycle fields or the actual outstanding capacity.

primary_attribution_and_claims.root_review: Root directly read Scheduling Page Table Walks ISCA2018 sectionIV p5-6 (reported lines586-702): recent-instruction batch, minimum overall PWC-ref score by instruction, age tie and aging; its reported input does not include payload cell last-owner. Root also read JSAC1997 Multicast Scheduling for Input-Queued Switches: fan-out split and Concentrate/TATRA last-child packet retirement principles.
primary_attribution_and_claims.scope: Those primary facts establish the generic principles and an input/interface difference. They do not alone establish an independent useful IOMMU contribution. This seat neither re-browsed nor claims those papers implement the exact permission-stage endpoint.
primary_attribution_and_claims.conditional_innovation: 如果真实pre-AW许可入场接口在同预算下利用owner-mask增加一个准确前作/完整simplecontrol不能复现的有用能力，并且完整W/B、native grant和上游准备成本闭合，就可以把那个窄差异作为贡献。因为当前singleton及coalition示例分别被stage-aware完成优先和max-occupancy/partner continuation复现，不能把这些手例当独立算法收益。

execution: No new model, RTL/Linux edits, large source scan, build, board action or literature search. Codex personally designed the masks/rule and hand tradeoffs. Root retains actual-source/primary acceptance; no current-DUT result is asserted.
